title: Every obligation traced to code and tests
statement: Every obligation in a product written in Lathe is designed, built and proved, so the Owner can tell from the spec alone what is done.
measure: The obligations that the coverage of `lathe check` counts as designed, built and proved, over all obligations, summed over every domain of Lathe's own spec and the Tool Library.
target: 100% designed, built and proved in both products on every merge into main, from the first published release of the package on.

title: Mistakes refused when made
statement: Data that breaks the model is refused when it is written, and the spec on main carries no problem.
measure: The errors and warnings that `lathe check` prints for Lathe's own spec and the Tool Library, counted on every merge into main.
target: 0 errors and 0 warnings on every merge into main, from now on.

title: Feedback within seconds
statement: The Owner and Agents learn within seconds whether a change keeps the spec whole.
measure: The median time to load and check Lathe's own spec cold, and to reload it live after one row changes, as the engine's performance suite (`npm --prefix lathe run test:perf`) measures them.
target: A cold load under 2 s and a live reload under 500 ms on every performance run before a release.

title: Readers find their way without waiting
statement: A Reader opens and reads any record of a product in the app quickly, with nothing on the page jumping and every page usable by keyboard and screen reader.
measure: The app's performance suite (the time until a record page is interactive, the main-thread work of a view switch), the layout shifts the stability suite records, and the WCAG 2.2 AA violations the accessibility suite's audit finds.
target: A record page interactive within 1.5 s, a view switch under 100 ms, and 0 layout shifts and 0 violations on every page the suites visit, before each release.

title: Any product can adopt Lathe
statement: A product adopts Lathe in its own repo and adds the kinds it needs without forking the schema.
measure: The product repos outside this one whose `lathe check` runs on the published package with its schema unchanged, counted from the installs the Owner knows of.
target: At least two such product repos, none with a forked schema, within six months of the first published release.
